questions.q: How did Beauty know who was coming down the road near midnight?
choices: He could tell it was Ginger's step
He saw the lantern swinging on the dog-cart
He heard York calling his name in the dark
He smelled the men's pipes from far away
questions.evidence: I was almost sure I could distinguish Ginger's step

questions.q: What had happened to Reuben Smith when the men found him?
choices: He was dead
He was asleep
He had a broken arm
He had walked home

questions.q: Why did Robert think "it hasn't been all right with Reuben"?
choices: No sober man would ride over those stones without a shoe
Reuben had left a note at the inn saying he was ill
Reuben was found with an empty bottle in his hand
The hostler at the White Lion had said he was sick
questions.evidence: Just think of his riding a horse over these stones without a shoe!

questions.q: What did Ginger do while the men put the body into the dog-cart?
choices: Stood as still as a stone
Pulled away and ran back home
Kicked hard at the cart wheels
Neighed loudly the whole time
questions.evidence: stood as still as a stone

questions.q: How did Robert help Beauty get home?
choices: He bound his foot with a handkerchief and led him slowly
He rode him home slowly through the fields by moonlight
He left him tied to a tree by the road until morning
He walked him to the nearest farm and left him there
questions.evidence: he took his handkerchief and bound it closely round, and so he led me home

questions.q: What did the farrier say would happen to Beauty's knees?
choices: He would never lose the blemish
They would heal with no mark at all
He would never be able to work again
They would need bandages for the rest of his life
questions.evidence: I should never lose the blemish

questions.q: An "inquest" was held because Smith died suddenly. What is an inquest?
choices: An official inquiry to find out how someone died
A church service held to bury someone who died
A sale where a dead man's horses are auctioned off
A kind of medicine given after a bad accident
questions.evidence: As Smith's death had been so sudden, and no one was there to see it, there was an inquest held.

questions.q: What lesson does this chapter show about drinking?
choices: Drink brought death to Reuben and ruin to his family
Drinking a little makes people braver riders at night
Only the horses are really hurt when men drink
Drinking is all right if you are clever at your work
questions.evidence: It was all that cursed drink
